patterns.note: Full-width content sections with varying background colors are used to delineate major content blocks, often featuring asymmetrical arrangements of text and imagery.
Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual impact and hierarchy against smaller, lighter body text.
A high-contrast dark mode theme is established with predominantly black and dark grey backgrounds, punctuated by vibrant, full-bleed accent colors (teal and peach) for distinct sections.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling, creating a dynamic content loading experience.
Each major content block is presented as a full-bleed section with a unique background color (dark, teal, or peach), providing clear visual separation and a distinct rhythm to the page.

technique_notes: A full-width video hero automatically plays on page load, setting an immersive and dynamic tone for the site.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, ensuring constant access to key site sections.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle animation, appearing to fade and slide upwards as they become visible within the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for navigation and sub-elements.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners for images and primary content blocks, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like input fields and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and comfortable spacing within content grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, almost black, background combined with unexpected, vibrant full-bleed accent colors (teal and peach) for entire sections creates a sophisticated and modern aesthetic that feels both artistic and tech-forward. This bold color blocking against a dark canvas is highly memorable.
